newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Stocks Hotels & Resorts floats on JSE.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Stocks Hotels & Resorts floats on JSE.

text.p: South Africa's Stocks Hotels & Resorts Ltd said on Monday that it had listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) in a move which should inject 112 million rand of fresh cash and give it a market capitalisation of around 250 million rand.

A block of eight million shares has also been placed at a discount premium with four black empowerment groups. They are Letsha Investment Ltd, Sedimoza Ltd, Western Cape Consortium and Western-Eastern Cape Black Empowerment Consortium.
Parent firm construction group Stocks & Stocks Ltd will retain a 40.33 percent stake in the firm.
The firm's separate listing is aimed at strengthening the hotel unit's balance sheet and allowing it to focus on its own concerns, of which bidding for gambling licenses is a key area.
Bids are to be made for 10 licenses, focussing on the Western Cape province. Excluding the boon of securing a license, the hotels unit also expects earnings to grow by some 25 percent a year.
